en.text: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.

zhSimplified.text: 住在地，就是他父亲寄居的地。

zhTraditional.text: 住在地，就是他父親寄居的地。

en.text: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

zhSimplified.text: 的记略如下。 十七岁与他哥哥们一同牧羊。他是个童子，与他父亲的妾、的儿子们常在一处。将他哥哥们的恶行报给他们的父亲。

zhTraditional.text: 的記略如下。 十七歲與他哥哥們一同牧羊。他是個童子，與他父親的妾、的兒子們常在一處。將他哥哥們的惡行報給他們的父親。

en.text: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.

zhSimplified.text: 原来爱过于爱他的众子，因为是他年老生的；他给做了一件彩衣。

zhTraditional.text: 原來愛過於愛他的眾子，因為是他年老生的；他給做了一件彩衣。

en.text: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

zhSimplified.text: 的哥哥们见父亲爱过于爱他们，就恨，不与他说和睦的话。

zhTraditional.text: 的哥哥們見父親愛過於愛他們，就恨，不與他說和睦的話。

en.text: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

zhSimplified.text: 做了一梦，告诉他哥哥们，他们就越发恨他。

zhTraditional.text: 做了一夢，告訴他哥哥們，他們就越發恨他。

en.text: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

zhSimplified.text: 对他们说：「请听我所做的梦：

zhTraditional.text: 對他們說：「請聽我所做的夢：

en.text: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们在田里捆禾稼，我的捆起来站着，你们的捆来围着我的捆下拜。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們在田裏捆禾稼，我的捆起來站着，你們的捆來圍着我的捆下拜。」

en.text: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

zhSimplified.text: 他的哥哥们回答说：「难道你真要作我们的王吗？难道你真要管辖我们吗？」他们就因为他的梦和他的话越发恨他。

zhTraditional.text: 他的哥哥們回答說：「難道你真要作我們的王嗎？難道你真要管轄我們嗎？」他們就因為他的夢和他的話越發恨他。

en.text: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

zhSimplified.text: 后来他又做了一梦，也告诉他的哥哥们说：「看哪，我又做了一梦，梦见太阳、月亮，与十一个星向我下拜。」

zhTraditional.text: 後來他又做了一夢，也告訴他的哥哥們說：「看哪，我又做了一夢，夢見太陽、月亮，與十一個星向我下拜。」

en.text: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”

zhSimplified.text: 将这梦告诉他父亲和他哥哥们，他父亲就责备他说：「你做的这是什么梦！难道我和你母亲、你弟兄果然要来俯伏在地，向你下拜吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 將這夢告訴他父親和他哥哥們，他父親就責備他說：「你做的這是甚麼夢！難道我和你母親、你弟兄果然要來俯伏在地，向你下拜嗎？」

en.text: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

zhSimplified.text: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这话存在心里。

zhTraditional.text: 他哥哥們都嫉妒他，他父親卻把這話存在心裏。

en.text: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

zhSimplified.text: 的哥哥们往去放他们父亲的羊。

zhTraditional.text: 的哥哥們往去放他們父親的羊。

en.text: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

zhSimplified.text: 对说：「你哥哥们不是在放羊吗？你来，我要打发你往他们那里去。」说：「我在这里。」

zhTraditional.text: 對說：「你哥哥們不是在放羊嗎？你來，我要打發你往他們那裏去。」說：「我在這裏。」

en.text: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「你去看看你哥哥们平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回来报信给我」；于是打发他出，他就往去了。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「你去看看你哥哥們平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回來報信給我」；於是打發他出，他就往去了。

en.text: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

zhSimplified.text: 有人遇见他在田野走迷了路，就问他说：「你找什么？」

zhTraditional.text: 有人遇見他在田野走迷了路，就問他說：「你找甚麼？」

en.text: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

zhSimplified.text: 他说：「我找我的哥哥们，求你告诉我，他们在何处放羊。」

zhTraditional.text: 他說：「我找我的哥哥們，求你告訴我，他們在何處放羊。」

en.text: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

zhSimplified.text: 那人说：「他们已经走了，我听见他们说要往去。」就去追赶他哥哥们，遇见他们在。

zhTraditional.text: 那人說：「他們已經走了，我聽見他們說要往去。」就去追趕他哥哥們，遇見他們在。

en.text: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

zhSimplified.text: 他们远远地看见他，趁他还没有走到跟前，大家就同谋要害死他，

zhTraditional.text: 他們遠遠地看見他，趁他還沒有走到跟前，大家就同謀要害死他，

en.text: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

zhSimplified.text: 彼此说：「你看！那做梦的来了。

zhTraditional.text: 彼此說：「你看！那做夢的來了。

en.text: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

zhSimplified.text: 来吧！我们将他杀了，丢在一个坑里，就说有恶兽把他吃了。我们且看他的梦将来怎么样。」

zhTraditional.text: 來吧！我們將他殺了，丟在一個坑裏，就說有惡獸把他吃了。我們且看他的夢將來怎麼樣。」

en.text: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

zhSimplified.text: 听见了，要救他脱离他们的手，说：「我们不可害他的性命」；

zhTraditional.text: 聽見了，要救他脫離他們的手，說：「我們不可害他的性命」；

en.text: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

zhSimplified.text: 又说：「不可流血，可以把他丢在这野地的坑里，不可下手害他。」的意思是要救他脱离他们的手，把他归还他的父亲。

zhTraditional.text: 又說：「不可流血，可以把他丟在這野地的坑裏，不可下手害他。」的意思是要救他脫離他們的手，把他歸還他的父親。

en.text: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

zhSimplified.text: 到了他哥哥们那里，他们就剥了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，

zhTraditional.text: 到了他哥哥們那裏，他們就剝了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，

en.text: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

zhSimplified.text: 把他丢在坑里；那坑是空的，里头没有水。

zhTraditional.text: 把他丟在坑裏；那坑是空的，裏頭沒有水。

en.text: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 他们坐下吃饭，举目观看，见有一伙的人从来，用骆驼驮着香料、乳香、没药，要带下去。

zhTraditional.text: 他們坐下吃飯，舉目觀看，見有一夥的人從來，用駱駝馱着香料、乳香、沒藥，要帶下去。

en.text: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

zhSimplified.text: 对众弟兄说：「我们杀我们的兄弟，藏了他的血有什么益处呢？

zhTraditional.text: 對眾弟兄說：「我們殺我們的兄弟，藏了他的血有甚麼益處呢？

en.text: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

zhSimplified.text: 我们不如将他卖给人，不可下手害他；因为他是我们的兄弟，我们的骨肉。」众弟兄就听从了他。

zhTraditional.text: 我們不如將他賣給人，不可下手害他；因為他是我們的兄弟，我們的骨肉。」眾弟兄就聽從了他。

en.text: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 有些的商人从那里经过，哥哥们就把从坑里拉上来，讲定二十舍客勒银子，把卖给人。他们就把带到去了。

zhTraditional.text: 有些的商人從那裏經過，哥哥們就把從坑裏拉上來，講定二十舍客勒銀子，把賣給人。他們就把帶到去了。

en.text: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

zhSimplified.text: 回到坑边，见不在坑里，就撕裂衣服，

zhTraditional.text: 回到坑邊，見不在坑裏，就撕裂衣服，

en.text: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

zhSimplified.text: 回到兄弟们那里，说：「童子没有了。我往哪里去才好呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 回到兄弟們那裏，說：「童子沒有了。我往哪裏去才好呢？」

en.text: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

zhSimplified.text: 他们宰了一只公山羊，把的那件彩衣染了血，

zhTraditional.text: 他們宰了一隻公山羊，把的那件彩衣染了血，

en.text: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”

zhSimplified.text: 打发人送到他们的父亲那里，说：「我们捡了这个；请认一认是你儿子的外衣不是？」

zhTraditional.text: 打發人送到他們的父親那裏，說：「我們撿了這個；請認一認是你兒子的外衣不是？」

en.text: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

zhSimplified.text: 他认得，就说：「这是我儿子的外衣。有恶兽把他吃了，被撕碎了！撕碎了！」

zhTraditional.text: 他認得，就說：「這是我兒子的外衣。有惡獸把他吃了，被撕碎了！撕碎了！」

en.text: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

zhSimplified.text: 便撕裂衣服，腰间围上麻布，为他儿子悲哀了多日。

zhTraditional.text: 便撕裂衣服，腰間圍上麻布，為他兒子悲哀了多日。

en.text: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.

footnotes.text: 37:35 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 他的儿女都起来安慰他，他却不肯受安慰，说：「我必悲哀着下阴间，到我儿子那里。」的父亲就为他哀哭。

zhTraditional.text: 他的兒女都起來安慰他，他卻不肯受安慰，說：「我必悲哀着下陰間，到我兒子那裏。」的父親就為他哀哭。

en.text: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

zhSimplified.text: 人带到，把他卖给法老的内臣—护卫长。

zhTraditional.text: 人帶到，把他賣給法老的內臣－護衛長。
